guides.definition: Starts an interactive Microsoft Graph session with an explicit least-privilege scope list. Requires the relevant Microsoft.Graph modules plus an authorized Microsoft 365 sign-in; Hypershell does not install or authenticate them.

parameters.name: scopes
parameters.description: Quoted scope or comma-separated quoted scopes required by the task.

examples.title: Connect for read-only user access
examples.explanation: Explicit scopes make the requested permissions visible before authentication and consent.

guides.definition: Uses server-side filtering and requests only the user properties needed by the result. Requires the relevant Microsoft.Graph modules plus an authorized Microsoft 365 sign-in; Hypershell does not install or authenticate them.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Quoted OData filter supported by the endpoint.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Maximum number of users requested for this page.

examples.title: Find enabled users
examples.explanation: Filtering and property projection reduce response volume; the signed-in identity still needs the matching Graph permission.

guides.definition: Issues a direct authenticated request through the Microsoft Graph PowerShell session. Requires the relevant Microsoft.Graph modules plus an authorized Microsoft 365 sign-in; Hypershell does not install or authenticate them.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Graph request method such as GET or POST.

examples.title: Read organization details
examples.explanation: Invoke-MgGraphRequest is useful when an SDK cmdlet does not yet expose an endpoint; validate the URI and permissions first.
